pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pOpens a portable crafting grid using the configured FE activation cost.$p$(l)Use$()$pCharge it, use it and craft with the current server’s crafting recipes. This is not a new process family and does not ignore ordinary crafting requirements.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:calculators/installing)Using modules inside a Flawless Calculator$()$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pObtain this module: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.
